name: Chronos-2 with covariates (HAR residual / quantile engine)
install_cmd: D:/nt/nt_mm_env/python.exe -m pip install chronos-forecasting "pandas[pyarrow]"  (after torch 2.11.0+cu126 from the cu126 index in the py3.11 venv)
windows_notes: Pure PyTorch, no custom kernels; expected to run on Windows, not run here. transformers<6.
test_plan: 5-min log RV, context 2048, target next-60-min log RV and T01 delta; arms HAR+ToD, zero-shot, with HAR/S3/ToD/T13 covariates, 50/50 with HAR, ridge stack; select 2019-01..2024-06, judge 2017-18 and Binance 2025-26; Spearman, QLIKE, pinball, 80% coverage vs T03/T05; MZ recalibration; block bootstrap.
build_on_path: HAR forecast as covariate so the model learns only the correction; quantiles as extra interval candidate; average or ridge stack with HAR/S3.

name: Tiny Time Mixers r2 (HAR ensemble partner)
install_cmd: D:/nt/nt_mm_env/python.exe -m pip install granite-tsfm  (needs Python>=3.11 and torch>=2.10,<2.12; for py3.10 only: pip install granite-tsfm==0.3.3 "torch<2.9")
windows_notes: Pure PyTorch; repo unmaintained (beta); r2 pretraining list includes Bitcoin (contamination); fixed context 512/1024/1536, prediction length by branch name; point forecasts only.
weights: HF ibm-granite/granite-timeseries-ttm-r2 (805k params, a few MB)
test_plan: 5-min log RV with HAR/ToD channels, context 512; zero-shot and fine-tuned on 10% of selection months; compare HAR+ToD vs TTM vs 50/50 average, MZ-recalibrated, QLIKE and Spearman; judge 2017-18 and Binance 2025-26.
build_on_path: Equal-weight average with HAR/S3 first (the pattern with evidence, Brini 2607.05291), then ridge stack; add quantile loss only if point forecast helps.

name: Kronos (tokenised K-line model): path sampling for range and barrier-hit
install_cmd: C:/Users/Step/miniforge3/Scripts/conda.exe create -y -p D:/nt/nt_mm_legacy python=3.10 && D:/nt/nt_mm_legacy/python.exe -m pip install torch==2.5.1 --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu124 && git clone https://github.com/shiyu-coder/Kronos D:/nt/nt_mm_cache/src_kronos && D:/nt/nt_mm_legacy/python.exe -m pip install -r D:/nt/nt_mm_cache/src_kronos/requirements.txt
windows_notes: Not on PyPI; exact pins clash with modern transformers so keep a separate env; skip pyqlib/torchrun fine-tune (no nvcc/MSVC); run with cwd or PYTHONPATH = the clone.
weights: HF NeoQuasar/Kronos-small (24.7M, ctx 512), Kronos-mini (4.1M, ctx 2048), tokenizers; large not open
test_plan: Use only windows from 2024-07-01 (pretraining ends 2024-06): cut-file 2024-07..2025-07-20 plus Binance forward; 500 windows, 30 samples, pred_len 60; sampled range quantile coverage, Spearman of path-implied vol vs HAR, P(hit) Brier/AUC vs H3; null = HAR-scaled Gaussian paths; temperature/top_p sensitivity.
build_on_path: Add Kronos-range and Kronos-P(hit) as features to the H3 logistic and S3 ridge; embeddings as a candle-shape view next to geometry lines.

name: Regime card: chart image + numeric + templated caption fusion (CNN/CLIP with geometry-line channels)
repo: own code; reference https://github.com/mlfoundations/open_clip and https://github.com/CityMind-Lab/ICML25-TimeVLM (do not install the latter)
install_cmd: D:/nt/nt_mm_env/python.exe -m pip install open_clip_torch mplfinance lightgbm scikit-learn pillow
windows_notes: Render with numpy/PIL into a uint8 memmap, num_workers=0; no custom kernels.
weights: OpenAI CLIP ViT-B/32 via open_clip (~600 MB), or train a 4-layer CNN from scratch
test_plan: 96x96 charts of last 120 min with T13 lines as channels; frozen CLIP + PCA32 and a small CNN on a 6-hour-per-month layout; target S3-ridge residual of next-hour vol change, H3 logit secondary; ladder numeric/+image/+caption/+both; controls: shuffled embeddings, lines removed, information-equivalent numeric features; judge 2017-18 and Binance 2025-26.
build_on_path: Fit on the S3 ridge residual (baseline Spearman 0.4475, not bare HAR); point at vol change where T13 lines help, not at H3 where they did not.

name: VisionTS / VisionTS++ (image-MAE seasonal forecaster as a feature)
modality: time series folded into an image, frozen MAE
windows_notes: Pure PyTorch/timm; MAE checkpoint fetched via huggingface-hub; repo last pushed 2025; use 5-min bars with period 288 rather than 1-min with 1440 (224-px image).
weights: MAE ViT-B ImageNet (~330 MB estimate); VisionTS++ HF Lefei/VisionTSpp
test_plan: 5-min log range and log volume, 7-day context, period 288, zero-shot mean forecast for next hour as one column; HAR+ToD vs +VisionTS vs seasonal-median control; VisionTS++ quantiles vs HAR intervals; 5 judgement folds, block bootstrap.
build_on_path: One extra HAR regressor; quantiles into the T03/T05 interval comparison. Cheap kill-or-keep.

name: Regime retrieval (FAISS analog correction of HAR residual and H3)
install_cmd: D:/nt/nt_mm_env/python.exe -m pip install faiss-cpu scikit-learn lightgbm
windows_notes: faiss-cpu 1.15.1 has cp310-cp314 Windows wheels; CPU only.
test_plan: 20 regime descriptors per 5-min anchor; index on months before t with D-034 purge gap; k=50 neighbours with recency weighting; features = mean neighbour HAR residual and barrier-hit rate; monthly walk-forward 2019-01..2024-06; judge 2017-18 and Binance 2025-26; control = random neighbours.
build_on_path: Feature added to S3 ridge and H3 logistic; retrieval keys include geometry-line distance, session and stretch factor.

name: TimesFM 2.5 as frozen feature generator
license: Code Apache-2.0; 2.5 weights Apache-2.0; 3.0 weights non-commercial
install_cmd: D:/nt/nt_mm_env/python.exe -m pip install "timesfm[torch]==2.0.2"  (model timesfm.TimesFM_2p5_200M_torch.from_pretrained('google/timesfm-2.5-200m-pytorch', torch_compile=False); do not add [xreg] on Windows)
windows_notes: Unpinned timesfm[torch] now installs 3.0.2 with non-commercial weights; torch_compile needs triton/MSVC so keep it off; XReg uses jax[cuda] with no Windows GPU build.
test_plan: Same 5-min RV walk-forward as Chronos-2: HAR+ToD, zero-shot, HAR + TimesFM-feature ridge, HAR + TimesFM + Chronos-2 features; MZ recalibration; QLIKE and Spearman.
build_on_path: Residual stacking: TimesFM forecast and quantile spread as features next to HAR, S3, ToD, line distances.

name: HAR-initialised network (HARNet-style) with multimodal feature inputs
repo: paper arXiv 2205.07719; no code verified, own implementation
install_cmd: D:/nt/nt_mm_env/python.exe -m pip install torch scikit-learn  (already present)
test_plan: Network initialised to reproduce the S3/HAR forecast exactly, trained with QLIKE; inputs added stepwise: ToD, T13 line distances, then FM and Kronos features from the winners of tests 1-6; monthly walk-forward; compare to ridge stack.
build_on_path: Single learned fusion head that cannot start worse than HAR; receives the surviving views as extra inputs.

name: Visibility-graph and wavelet-band features
windows_notes: ts2vg 1.2.4 needs only numpy and has win_amd64 wheels; CPU only.
test_plan: HVG mean degree, degree entropy, clustering and 6 CWT band energies on 60-bar close windows; ridge/logistic for next-hour log range and H3; control: same features on shuffled window order; increment over S3+T13.
build_on_path: Add to the T13 geometry feature set as scale-free interpretable indicators.

name: Sundial sampled paths for first-passage probabilities
install_cmd: D:/nt/nt_mm_legacy/python.exe -m pip install "numpy<2" "transformers==4.40.1" accelerate  (load thuml/sundial-base-128m with trust_remote_code=True after reading the repo code)

name: TabPFN (plain regressor/classifier) on T01/T10 feature tables
license: Weights non-commercial, click-through acceptance at ux.priorlabs.ai

name: Venn-Abers / ACI calibration of H3 on a pooled window
install_cmd: D:/nt/nt_mm_env/python.exe -m pip install venn-abers mapie  (venn-abers builds from sdist, pure Python; a 15-line numpy ACI is safer than the drifting MAPIE API)
test_plan: Fit on 6-12 months of pooled H3 probabilities (monthly isotonic was 3.9% worse in T12), score the next block; ECE only, Brier shown; use Venn-Abers [p0,p1] width as a calibration-uncertainty feature; ACI applied to a decision threshold or a TSFM-based scale.
build_on_path: Post-hoc layer on H3 (skill +15.4% Brier over B1 already; target ECE below 1 pp).
